real: Next, if i run the gossamer repo command from a repo already being indexed by gossamer, don't show me all the repos, just open the corresponding repo details page.
prev_agent: Done. The wizard now defaults "Auto-push sessions on git push?" to **yes** (`[Y/n]`), so pressing Enter skips the `--skip-push-sessions` flag and sessions land on the checkpoint branch in the same repo. Users can still opt out by typing `n`.
